selection: H47 uses one model response per task/repetition. model_read_ids are baseline; final_read_ids after zero-token effect closure are treatment.
treatment: At every validated terminal response, union at most six receipt-bound pinned-base observations overlapping actual changed ranges. No closure bytes are sent to the model.

branch_order.method: one candidate branch per task and repetition; baseline reconstructed from the identical terminal response

stopping_rules: No reruns. Missing and invalid trajectories are zero in both baseline and treatment.
claim_ceiling: Exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K same-trajectory development diagnostic; no untouched confirmation or full clearance.
